text: People use bikes to travel or exercise because the practice is clean and well-liked. Riders operate these two-wheeled machines on surfaces such as streets, bike paths, or trails. Individuals choose cycling for recreation, physical conditioning, or daily commuting since it maintains activity without excessive strain on the body. Stopping safely relies heavily on functioning brakes designed to reduce speed. The condition of the tires also matters greatly, influencing ride comfort, grip, and general efficiency. Inspecting tires for signs of wear and maintaining correct air pressure results in a more secure and comfortable experience.
